sarah: heads up — we saw a P95 latency regression on llama-3-13b after the latest runtime flip. noticed around 10:18am during the nightly perf sweep. :eyes:
perf-bot: profile summary attached -> cpu: kernel-selector v2 fallback to slow_kernel_v1; gpu: kernel hotpath v1.3.2, kv-evict spikes at 120ms, batch size drop from 8->3 on steady load. (report id: pr-196860)
miguel: can you paste the model config we rolled? suspect rope scaling change + head_dim mismatch triggered different kernel selection.
sarah: pasted below — this is what deployment used:```model: llama-3-13b
hidden_size: 5120
num_heads: 40
head_dim: 128
rope_theta: auto
norm: RMSNorm
activation: SiLU
chat_template: system+user prefix=512```
kevin: rope_theta: auto -> runtime picks theta ~ 1000 which for 5120 hid and 40 heads changes the stride heuristics. kernel-selector sees nonstandard head_dim/rope combos and prefers a generic matmul kernel that doesn't leverage fused qkv+kv-cache paths.
anya: looks like batching heuristics also reacted: because kv cache eviction was heavy (chat_template prefix 512), continuous batching couldn't reuse cached KV and effective batch dropped, amplifying per-token cost.
derek: I ran a quick local repro with smaller prefix and pinned kernel, results:```# repro commands
redwoodctl set-runtime-config --pool=dev-gpu --model=llama-3-13b --override-kernel=fast_qkv_fused_v2
runbench --seq=1024 --batch=8 --prefetch-kv=on```
kevin: results?
derek: pin -> p95 down 28%, throughput up ~22%. but with rope_theta:auto it still occasionally falls back when sequence patterns change.
miguel: hypothesis: rope_theta:auto leads to minor numeric changes that push attention implementation into a different codepath (sinusoid stride vs index-scaling). combined with head_dim 128 the kernel selector favors a generic GEMM when our specialized fused kernels expect head_dim multiple of 64.
sarah: so two levers: enforce rope_theta default to 512 for this model shape OR adjust kernel-selector thresholds to prefer fast_qkv_fused_v2 for head_dim=128 on our GPU family.
anya: we should also update chat template defaults — the system prefix of 512 is aggressive and causes lots of cold KV hits for short interactive sessions. recommend default system prefix 128 and optional long_context flag.
kevin: agree. quick mitigation plan: 1) rollback kernel-selector thresholds (selector flag: prefer_fused_for_headdim=128=true), 2) add runtime override to pin kernel for tenant pools, 3) change console template default to system_prefix=128, 4) add a perf test case with rope_theta variations to CI.
perf-bot: scheduled perf job: pr-196860-rollback-test queued on dev-gpu pool; expected runtime 45m.
sarah: assigning actions — miguel to update selector heuristics, derek to run A/B with override pinned across 24h window, anya to propose chat template change in console UX, kevin will add rope_theta permutations to the perf matrix.
miguel: quick note — when adjusting selector please add a soft-fallback metric so we can detect regression if fused kernel miscompiles on rare shapes. also add a logging tag: kernel_reason (rope_theta/head_dim/cache_hit).
derek: running A/B now. sharing logs when complete.``
